name: FOUNDER5-the-old-instant
note: 00:00Z again: a player who first played on the evening of the 24th in the Americas - before the 25th on their own clock - holds nothing.

name: FOUNDER5-the-cutoff-an-open-end
note: Every registered account a founder, however late it first played: the title is no longer closed.

name: FOUNDER5-the-cutoff-exclusive
note: The last second of the 24th at UTC-12 falls outside.

name: FOUNDER5-the-list-ignored
old: if (!held.includes('founder') && isNamedFounder(player, env)) held.push('founder');   // FOUNDER5: or by name
note: A player Mac names in FOUNDER_HANDLES holds nothing: the one way to reach a player no record proves is gone.

name: FOUNDER5-the-list-held-twice
old: if (!held.includes('founder') && isNamedFounder(player, env)) held.push('founder');   // FOUNDER5: or by name
new: if (isNamedFounder(player, env)) held.push('founder');   // FOUNDER5: or by name
note: A founder by the date AND the name is offered the title twice in the wardrobe.

name: FOUNDER5-the-list-grants-guests
why: Belt and braces, kept as the developers' and moderators' guards are: handleList drops empty entries, so no set holds '' and a guest's NULL handle - the one handle a guest has - is never in it. The guard says the law where it is read; the pin that a guest holds none (founder5's names) stands either way.

name: FOUNDER5-the-list-case-blind
note: A handle named in another case than it was registered in holds nothing - handle_lc is what uniqueness is on.
